sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
Interesting! Pressing ACTION7 7 times did NOT create any green blocks. The player just toggled between RIGHT and LEFT positions. This contradicts my earlier observation where ACTION7 created green blocks.
Let me re-examine what happened earlier. After I converted all 7 green blocks to sky blue, I pressed ACTION7 and it created a green block. But now, pressing ACTION7 just toggles the player.
Wait, maybe the green block creation only happens when there are 0 green blocks AND the sky blue region has a specific shape or size. Or maybe the green block creation was a one-time thing that only happened after I first converted the original 7 blocks.
Actually, let me reconsider. Earlier, after converting all 7 blocks, the sky blue region had a certain shape. Then ACTION7 created blocks at specific positions (cols 49-53, then 43-47). But now, after all these actions, the sky blue region has a different shape (since I converted those 2 blocks too). So maybe ACTION7 only creates blocks when the sky blue region has a specific shape that "needs" to be filled.
But this is getting too speculative. Let me think about what else I haven't tried.
I've tried:
1. LEFT/RIGHT - moves player
2. MOUSE on green blocks - converts to sky blue
3. MOUSE on sky blue - nothing
4. MOUSE on player - nothing
5. MOUSE on gray dots - nothing
6. MOUSE on black areas - nothing
7. MOUSE on HUD - advances purple bar
8. ACTION7 - toggles player (sometimes creates green blocks)
What if the goal involves the yellow part of the player? The player has a blue body (6 cells) and a yellow "head" or "arm" (2 cells). What if I need to click on the yellow part specifically?
Or what if the goal is to have the player face a specific direction? The yellow part might indicate the direction the player is facing.
Let me check the player's orientation. When the player is on LEFT, the yellow part is at cols 14-14 (left of the blue body at cols 15-16). When the player is on RIGHT, the yellow part is at cols 20-20 (left of the blue body at cols 21-22).
Wait, that's interesting. The yellow part is always to the LEFT of the blue body. So the player is always "facing" left?
Actually, looking at the segmentation:
- Player blue: rows 37-40, cols 15-16 (when on LEFT) or cols 21-22 (when on RIGHT)
- Yellow: rows 38-39, cols 14-14 (when on LEFT) or cols 20-20 (when on RIGHT)
So the yellow part is always at col = blue_col - 1. This means the yellow part is always to the LEFT of the blue body.
Hmm, but the player only moves between two positions (LEFT and RIGHT). The yellow part doesn't change relative to the blue body. So the player doesn't "face" different directions.
Let me try something completely different. What if I need to click on the yellow part of the player?
